thought.text: The failure at `.alert-info` might be a test assertion issue (the static hint box is `d-none`). Let me create 9901 via the infra spec and then manually exercise the Fachplanung creation end-to-end.

reasoning_content:
The error is because 9901 doesn't exist. That's the test data artifact: setup-docu-data deletes 9901 and only re-adds it if is_partial_run (when argv contains cypress/e2e/ but not 01-infrastruktur). When I manually curled, 9901 was deleted. In the full ordered run, 01-infrastruktur_setup creates 9901, so 030 fails at the "alert-info visible" assertion because the alert-info div is `d-none` (hidden by default, toggled by JS). Wait, in the full ordered run, the failure was at line 39 `.alert-info` should be visible — element has `d-none`. That suggests the form submission failed or JS didn't unhide. Actually the test at 030 line 39 expects `.alert-info` visible after clicking "Fachplanungen anlegen". The template's alert-info div has class `d-none` by default. After successful creation, addHtmlMessage adds a NEW alert-info (probably visible). But here the first `.alert-info` found is the d-none hint box.

Hmm, this is a plausible test robustness issue. But could indicate the creation didn't succeed. Let me test properly: recreate 9901 and try POST.

Actually, let me reconsider. The task is to validate the installation, not the test suite quality. The key question: does the software operate? The failures in specs 030/031/032/033 might be due to doc-data ordering/state, or genuine app defects.

Let me manually create 9901 and test the full fachplanung workflow end-to-end via HTTP. That's the real behavior test.

setup-docu-data deletes 99/9901. Then 01-infrastruktur creates them. So after full run they exist. But 030 failed even in ordered run. Let me investigate why: at line 39 expects `.alert-info` visible. After successful POST there should be a visible alert-info with "erfolgreich angelegt". But the assertion timed out because the element it found (d-none) was the static hint. Cypress `.alert-info` selects first matching? Actually `cy.get('.alert-info')` returns all matches and `.should('be.visible')` requires ALL to be visible in Cypress. So the static d-none hint box always makes it fail! That's a test bug, not app bug.

Wait, but the summary said 030 had 1/3 fail due to expected 2027 test data not present. Let me verify by doing the POST now with 9901 present.

Let me recreate 9901 via the infra spec alone, then POST.

action.command: cd /workspace; su - ddevuser -c 'cd /workspace && ddev setup-docu-data' >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run --rm --network ddev-tfm-fachplanung_default -e CYPRESS_baseUrl=http://web -e CYPRESS_user_r1=r1_user -e CYPRESS_pass_r1=r1_password -e CYPRESS_user_r2=r2_user -e CYPRESS_pass_r2=r2_password -e CYPRESS_user_r3=r3_user -e CYPRESS_pass_r3=r3_password -v /workspace:/e2e -w /e2e cypress/included:13.17.0 run --spec "cypress/e2e/01-infrastruktur_setup.cy.js" 2>&1 | grep -E "passing|failing|Tests:"; echo "== DB 9901 =="; su - ddevuser -c 'cd /workspace && ddev mysql -e "SELECT nummer,name FROM dienststelle WHERE nummer IN (99,9901);"' 2>&1 | tail -3
